<!-- Generated by internal/tools/docgen from the cobra command tree. DO NOT EDIT: run `make docs-reference`. -->

Calls any API endpoint, including ones without a dedicated command.
bronto adds the API key and sends the request to your region's base URL.

:::tip[Learn more]
The Bronto docs explain the platform concept behind this command: [docs.bronto.io/api-reference/introduction](https://docs.bronto.io/api-reference/introduction)
:::

```sh
bronto api <METHOD> <path> [flags]
```

#### Flags

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--content-type` |  | string | `application/json` | Content-Type header for request bodies |
| `--field` | `-f` | stringArray |  | key=value: a query parameter for GET/DELETE, a JSON body field otherwise (repeatable) |
| `--input` |  | string |  | read the request body from a file, or - for stdin |

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

#### Examples

```sh
bronto api GET /logs
bronto api GET /monitors -f limit=10
bronto api POST /search --input query.json
echo '{"time_range":"Last 15 minutes"}' | bronto api POST /search --input -
```
